children: The orders include a 534.3 MWp Balance of System package in Rajasthan and two BESS projects totalling 616 MWh in South Africa

Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy (SWREL) has secured new orders worth more than Rs 985 crore, comprising a 534.3 MWp solar project in Rajasthan and two Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects in South Africa with a combined capacity of 616 MWh.

The Rajasthan order, placed by a new customer, covers a Balance of System (BOS) package for a 534.3 MWp project. According to the company, the project is estimated to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by approximately 0.80 million upon commissioning.
The South African order has been placed by an existing customer and covers turnkey engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) work for two BESS projects with a combined capacity of 616 MWh.
The company said the South African project will be executed under a BESS turnkey EPC wrap arrangement.

Commenting on the orders, Chandra Kishore Thakur, Global CEO, Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy, said, “We are delighted to have received two prestigious orders each in Rajasthan and South Africa. Together, these orders reinforce the momentum in our business and the confidence customers place in our capabilities.”
The company said the orders include projects across solar and battery energy storage in India and overseas.
